Fix: make the number claim atomic rather than check-then-write. Create the record with `flag: "wx"` at the allocated number FIRST, then on `EEXIST` re-read and retry the allocation (or fail naming the conflicting path); alternatively scan for any `ADR-NNN-*.md` immediately after the write and refuse if a second one is present.
